name: Demo - Service performance
description: Synthetic service volumes and response times by fictional business unit.
businessUse: Compare sample service performance; not suitable for operational decisions.
limitations: Entirely synthetic. Values do not represent any customer.

name: Demo - Service feedback
description: Synthetic feedback scores with no customer identities or free-text personal data.
limitations: Generated scores, not observed customer sentiment.

name: Demo - Delivery performance
description: Synthetic delivery duration by fictional site.

name: Demo - Operational capacity
description: Synthetic available capacity for planning demonstrations.
limitations: Not a forecast or a commitment.

name: Demo - Inventory levels
description: Synthetic inventory quantities for fictional items and sites.
limitations: No real stock or regulated materials.

name: Demo - Supplier performance
description: Synthetic supplier delivery scores using fictional reference identifiers.
limitations: Not a commercial assessment of any supplier.

name: Demo - Quality checks
description: Synthetic quality observations and review status.
limitations: No production, safety or regulatory evidence.

name: Demo - Experiment catalogue
description: Fictional experiment metadata for knowledge discovery demonstrations.
limitations: No scientific findings, patient records or medical recommendations.

name: Demo - Financial ledger
description: Synthetic amounts by fictional cost centre, using demonstration currency units.
limitations: No real transactions, budgets or currency valuations.

name: Demo - Workforce summary
description: Synthetic aggregate team capacity without employee identities.
limitations: All groups and counts are fictional; demonstrate aggregation controls only.

name: Demo - Endpoint telemetry
description: Synthetic device response measurements using fictional device references.
limitations: Not real security telemetry or availability evidence.

name: Demo - API usage sample
description: Synthetic request counts for explaining gateway reporting; separate from live APIM analytics.
limitations: Illustrative rows only. Live gateway metrics are sourced separately from APIM.

name: Demo - Catalogue quality
description: Synthetic metadata completeness scores for governed discovery demonstrations.
limitations: Not an assessment of the connected estate.
